newsitem.title: USA: Tencor Instruments wins $8 mln contract.
newsitem.headline: Tencor Instruments wins $8 mln contract.

text.p: Tencor Instruments, a maker of equipment used to produce semiconductors, on Tuesday said it won a contract, valued over $8.0 million, from Korean manufacturer Samsung Electronics Co Ltd.
The order spans Tencor's Wafer Inspection, Film Measurement and Metrology divisions, and it includes several introduced Prometrix UV-1280SE thin film measurement systems.
Five UV-1280SE systems will be delivered to Samsung's new plant in Austin, Texas. The balance of the Prometrix UV-1280SE order will be delivered in Korea. Installation is scheduled throughout 1997.
